jobs:
  build-v1:
    name: Build v1 (Go ${{ matrix.go-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.20.x', '1.21.x', '1.22.x', '1.23.x', '1.24.x', '1.25.x', '1.26.x', '1.27.x']
      fail-fast: false  # Continue with other versions if one fails
    steps:
      # full checkout for semantic-release
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true  # Enable Go module caching
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go mod tidy
          go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.txt -covermode=atomic -coverpkg=./... ./...

build-v2:
    name: Build v2 (Go ${{ matrix.go-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.24.x', '1.25.x', '1.26.x', '1.27.x']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true  # Enable Go module caching
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd v2
          go mod tidy
          go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.txt -covermode=atomic -coverpkg=./... ./...

build-gen:
    name: Build gen/v2 (Go ${{ matrix.go-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.26.x', '1.27.x']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd gen/v2
          go mod tidy
          go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.txt -covermode=atomic -coverpkg=./... ./...

Installation
------------

Install Redigo using the "go get" command:

    go get github.com/gomodule/redigo/redis

The Go distribution is Redigo's only dependency.

- name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v5
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: latest
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version:
        - '1.21'
        - '1.22'
        os:
        - 'ubuntu-latest'
        redis:
        - '7.2'
        - '7.0'
        - '6.2'
        - '6.0'
    name: Test go ${{ matrix.go-version }} redis ${{ matrix.redis }} on ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Setup redis
        uses: shogo82148/actions-setup-redis@v1
        with:
          redis-version: ${{ matrix.redis }}

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
